================================================================================
field ending at a line break
================================================================================
class A {
	int a
	int b
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_class (identifier) (class_body
	(decl_field (type_int) (identifier))
	(decl_field (type_int) (identifier)))))

================================================================================
local declaration ending at a line break
================================================================================
void f() {
	int a = 1
	Print(a);
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method (type_void) (identifier) (block
	(decl_variable (type_int) (identifier) (literal_int))
	(statement_expression
		(invokation (identifier) (actual_parameters
			(actual_parameter (identifier))))))))

================================================================================
continue and break before a closing brace and before a statement
================================================================================
void f() {
	while (a) {
		continue
	}
	while (b) {
		break
		Print(b);
	}
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method (type_void) (identifier) (block
	(while (identifier) (block
		(continue)))
	(while (identifier) (block
		(break)
		(statement_expression
			(invokation (identifier) (actual_parameters
				(actual_parameter (identifier))))))))))

================================================================================
return before a closing brace and before a statement
================================================================================
void f() {
	return x
	Print(x);
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method (type_void) (identifier) (block
	(return (identifier))
	(statement_expression
		(invokation (identifier) (actual_parameters
			(actual_parameter (identifier))))))))

================================================================================
a binary expression continues on the next line
================================================================================
int c = d
	+ e;
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_variable (type_int) (identifier)
	(expression_binary (identifier) (identifier))))

================================================================================
a comment before a continuation does not end the statement
================================================================================
void f() {
	bool r = a // note
		&& b;
	int c = a /* note
	*/ + b;
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method (type_void) (identifier) (block
	(decl_variable (type_bool) (identifier)
		(expression_binary (identifier) (comment_line) (identifier)))
	(decl_variable (type_int) (identifier)
		(expression_binary (identifier) (comment_block) (identifier))))))

================================================================================
call arguments and a member access continue on the next line
================================================================================
void f() {
	h(i,
		j);
	x
		.M();
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit
	(decl_method
		return_type: (type_void)
		name: (identifier)
		body: (block
			(statement_expression
				(invokation
					invoked: (identifier)
					(actual_parameters
						(actual_parameter
							(identifier))
						(actual_parameter
							(identifier)))))
			(statement_expression
				(invokation
					instance: (identifier)
					invoked: (identifier)
					(actual_parameters))))))

================================================================================
a call and an else keep their shape after a preprocessor line
================================================================================
void f() {
#ifdef X
	A();
#endif
	B();
	if (b)
		C();
	else
		D();
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit (decl_method return_type: (type_void) name: (identifier) body: (block
	(preproc_ifdef (preproc_const))
	(statement_expression (invokation invoked: (identifier) (actual_parameters)))
	(preproc_endif)
	(statement_expression (invokation invoked: (identifier) (actual_parameters)))
	(if
		condition: (identifier)
		consequence: (statement_expression (invokation invoked: (identifier) (actual_parameters)))
		alternative: (statement_expression (invokation invoked: (identifier) (actual_parameters)))))))
